text: Friends, I just came from the orchard, and the apple trees are in fine shape. My bees love them: in spring the blossoms hum all day, and by autumn the same trees reward us with sweet, crisp fruit. Plant a few apple trees and the bees will thank you, and so will your pies.
speaker: ada

text: The pond is quiet in the morning, and I like that. I come here to play my music where the water carries it. If you listen, the ripples keep time.
speaker: bo
